programs.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Lakefront Luxe on a Budget in Wabash Valley, Illinois
programs.desc: The Wabash River winds its way through Indiana and Illinois; this family is looking for the perfect lakeside fixer-upper in the southwestern part of the valley; but the pitfalls of renovation may push their project over budget.

programs.title: Home Reimagined
programs.desc: Host and designer Vern Yip travels across the country to mentor brave renovators who have taken on the task of converting unusual commercial and industrial spaces into one-of-a-kind family homes.

programs.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: A Renovation for Future Generations on Skiatook Lake
programs.desc: A married couple is on the hunt for a property on Oklahoma's Skiatook Lake, with plans to transform it into the ultimate lakeside retreat; a place to create lasting memories and eventually pass down to future generations of their family.

programs.title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
programs.desc: Joanna bakes her kids' favorite treats like cinnamon pecan Bundt cake and her signature banana bread; she also shares a look at her rose garden and flower preservation techniques.

programs.title: Ranch to Table
programs.desc: It's holiday season on the ranch, and Elizabeth Poett is making favorites and sweet treats for friends and family. She prepares a Sausage, Gruyère and Mushroom Strata. Then, she makes Thumbprint Cookies and Chocolate Truffles as gifts for neighbors.
